<function name="IsNPC" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Checks if the entity is an <page>NPC</page> or not.

This will return false for <page>NextBot</page>s, see <page>Entity:IsNextBot</page> for that.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the entity is an NPC.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
